body.title: RepoSchemaGate guards at the daemon entry points
body.summary: Call RepoSchemaGate.require(repo, 2) at the entry of src/daemon/workflow-rpc.ts, workflow-review-rpc.ts, code-review-rpc.ts, artifacts-rpc.ts, tracker-attach.ts and tracker-sync-comments.ts, and of the step handlers src/daemon/steps/analyze-step/handler.ts, build-step/handler.ts, code-review-step/handler.ts, review-step/handler.ts, triage-step/handler.ts and workflow-step/handler.ts; repo.convert is exempt. Test src/daemon/__tests__/repo-schema-entry-points.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: Each listed daemon entry point refuses an unconverted repository with a message naming the conversion

tests.name: repo-schema-entry-points.test.ts: each daemon entry point refuses an unconverted repository with the conversion message
